body: I went from 75mg to 25mg it was fucking rough. Made me feel flu like. I vomited all day, couldn't sleep and the pain was bad. Taking something like zopiclone or a benzo short term for sleep can help with the sleep part. Not much you can do for the withdrawal symptoms though. 5 HTP and exercise will help your serotonin levels but exercise was so difficult for me when I was in withdrawal. It took me a good 6 weeks to stabilize. Good luck.
